naming: Each scenario has one id used unchanged as the replay file name (evidence/replays/<id>.json), the API id (/api/scenarios/<id>/replay), the frontend key and the button test id (replay-<id>).

scenarios.title: Launch & Formation
scenarios.summary: Nine 3x3 sections launch from coastal pads, climb their pre-cleared lanes and set the grid before engaging.

scenarios.title: Intercept Success
scenarios.summary: The lead drone hits H000 first time; duplicate claimants see it commit and stand down.

scenarios.title: Miss & Recovery
scenarios.summary: The lead misses H000, coverage expires, and a reserve observer claims and destroys it with no command.

scenarios.title: Multi-Wave Attack
scenarios.summary: Wave 1 is engaged, engaged drones return to rearm, reserves refill the empty cells, then wave 2 arrives.

scenarios.title: Return to Base
scenarios.summary: Platoon A1 starts low on battery, aborts at 25% after engaging and flies home by dead reckoning.

scenarios.title: Friend or Foe
scenarios.summary: Two friendly transit tracks cross the front; beacon loss leaves them UNKNOWN, never hostile, and they are never engaged.

scenarios.title: Naive Baseline
scenarios.summary: Same company, hostiles and seed as Miss & Recovery, but every drone chooses greedily with no coverage model.
